title: A chain and a branch
hook: Count the atoms and trace their bonds.

knows: Condensed structural formulas and covalent bonds.
doesNotKnow: Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀, but their atoms connect differently. butane and 2-methylpropane are constitutional isomers.

misconception: Different-looking structural drawings must represent different formulas or different compounds.
objective: Compare molecular formula and connectivity when classifying two structures.

claims.text: Structure A is butane (C₄H₁₀); structure B is 2-methylpropane (C₄H₁₀). Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀, but their atoms connect differently. butane and 2-methylpropane are constitutional isomers.
Constitutional isomers have the same molecular formula but different atomic connectivity.
The diagrams show condensed connectivity, not stereochemistry or molecular geometry.
Recall: What relationship do butane and 2-methylpropane have? Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀, but their atoms connect differently. butane and 2-methylpropane are constitutional isomers.
